subject.title: [Task] Harden browser/search stack and evaluate Lightpanda

question: Should this remain a broad browser/search hardening tracker, or should maintainers split it into separate Lightpanda/browser-backend, search-provider bug, and benchmark-matrix issues?
rationale: The request crosses browser backend selection, CDP/noVNC security, web_fetch/web_search product behavior, and benchmarking, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent scope or security boundary.

options.title: Split into approved tracks
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers split or sponsor narrower issues for browser backend evaluation, search-provider regressions, and benchmark evidence with explicit acceptance criteria.

options.title: Make this the benchmark tracker
options.body: Narrow this issue to the comparative matrix only and let the open browser-backed access and external CDP/noVNC issues own backend/product changes.

options.title: Close after canonicalizing slices
options.body: Close this umbrella only after maintainers confirm the remaining work is fully owned by narrower open issues and no cross-tool matrix is still wanted.

recommendation.title: Split into approved tracks
recommendation.body: Keep this open until maintainers split or sponsor narrower issues for browser backend evaluation, search-provider regressions, and benchmark evidence with explicit acceptance criteria.

likelyOwner.reason: The browser plugin boundary, web-tool split, and recent browser/security history point most strongly to steipete for product-direction routing.
